entities.summary: Volodymyr Yuriyovich Yelchenko is a Ukrainian diplomat. His latest post was the Ambassador of Ukraine to the United States, from December 2019 until February 2021. Previously to this appointment, he was the Permanent Representative of Ukraine to the United Nations since December 9, 2015. and was formerly Ambassador of Ukraine to Russia from July 2010 until he was recalled for consultations in March 2014.
